title: Transformative Digital Collections of Art
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: This monograph takes digital collections as a starting point to examine the implications of the availability of digital images and metadata for museums and art history. It highlights the need for digital literacy and technological skills to present art, engage audiences, and conduct research in digital environments. Addressing the challenges and opportunities of digital transformation—and including appendices with reusable datasets, tools, and examples—it is an essential resource for art historians, museum professionals, and the GLAM community.
